title: Actua Golf
overview:
The latest in the ground breaking Actua Sports series.

- Live interactive commentary
- Spectacular scenery using 3D technology combined with state of the art motion capture
- Two challenging courses to fully test your golfing skills
- Fully customised players and club selection
- True playing environment enabling total freedom of movement
- Multi-player options
- Multi-View shot tracking and replay
- Save game options to track your improvement.
